crossRefs.note: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his breast, saying, ‘God…
Surely after that I was turned. I repented. After that I was instructed. I struck my thigh. I was ashamed, yes, even…
Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what…

translations.web: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their breasts.
translations.bsb: And when all the people who had gathered for this spectacle saw what had happened, they returned home beating their breasts.
translations.kjv: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.
translations.asv: And all the multitudes that came together to this sight, when they beheld the things that were done, returned smiting their breasts.
